description: Electric vehicle charging order data is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Pengjun Zhao, Qing Yu. Charging record data were collected from Shanghai and Guangzhou, China, comprising a dataset of 769,225 charging orders from 1,702 public charging stations and covers a 31-day period from January 1 to January 31, 2024. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 13513961 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
